baseline.limitation: The original 12 cases reproduce cleared caller styles and late orientation locking. Migrated styles were subsequently compared per owned CSS property because resize legitimately updates control variables. The controlled clock was explicitly paused to eliminate wall-clock drift. Native orientation lock cases are controlled, not physical-device evidence.

remaining: Remaining display restoration failures and final distribution acceptance
Further mode composition and failure boundaries; physical Safari/iOS evidence
Historical public PiP getter declaration reconciliation in CORE-21
Final installed UMD/legacy and consumer acceptance; CORE-16 remains doing with open risks and no completed-task commit
